title: Python 3 Fundamentals
description: Write and run real Python 3 directly in your browser using WebAssembly (Pyodide). Master variables, control flow, functions, lists, dictionaries, comprehensions, and an auto-graded capstone.
outcomes: Write clean Python 3 code with variables, f-strings, and core data types
Control program flow with if/elif/else, for loops, and range()
Build reusable functions with default parameters and return values
Transform data cleanly using lists, dictionaries, and comprehensions
Pass an auto-graded Python capstone challenge in the browser
